purpose: Given current artifacts and intent, name the next BlendOps skill or workflow stage and preconditions to advance.
triggers: where are we in the workflow

exclusions.condition: Initial goal is vague or entry point is unknown
exclusions.reason: Triages ambiguous entry requests at precedence Rank 1

exclusions.condition: Goal is clear but no recipe or pack has been chosen yet
exclusions.reason: Selects the fitting recipe/pack at precedence Rank 2

exclusions.condition: Pack is selected and brief exists, but pack preflight has not completed yet
exclusions.reason: Executes preflight readiness verification at precedence Rank 3 before stage routing

exclusions.condition: Active MCP runtime bridge conflict on port 9876
exclusions.reason: Resolves port and dual add-on conflicts before advancing

exclusions.condition: Final stakeholder-facing wording and plain-language summary
exclusions.reason: Formats validated workflow outputs for non-Blender users

required.name: current_artifact_inventory
required.description: Determines current milestone stage and downgrade-only truth labels

required.name: active_intent
required.description: Prevents routing to the wrong domain branch

handoffs.label: Active MCP bridge conflict on port 9876
Mid-workflow scope expansion or unapproved deliverable addition
Evidence updates for render or export outputs
